name: Necklace of Succession

name: Pendant of Permafrost

title: Wrothgar Daily Contract Recompense
flavorText: Compensation from the Dragonstar Caravan Company for fulfilling a daily job contract in Wrothgar.
name: Wrothgar Daily Contract Recompense

title: Summerset Hills 572
flavorText: A bottle of white wine. According to the label, it is renowned for its "overpowering subtlety."
name: Summerset Hills 572

title: Hubalajad Palace Kitchen Key
flavorText: An elaborate ivory key.
name: Hubalajad Palace Kitchen Key

title: Silver Anvil Paperweight
flavorText: This miniature anvil is wrought from the finest silver—a paperweight fit for a chief.
name: Silver Anvil Paperweight

title: Fine Echatere Vellum
flavorText: This vellum is aromatic and smooth to the touch. Perfect for writing both poetry and death-threats.
name: Fine Echatere Vellum

title: Silver Knuckle-Stamp
flavorText: A massive silver signet, carved to resemble an Orc fist. A fine tool for sealing threatening letters.
name: Silver Knuckle-Stamp

title: Echalette-Skull Ink Well
flavorText: This inkwell appears both delicate and intimidating. The beast's tiny tusks serve as perfect pen-holders.
name: Echalette-Skull Ink Well

title: Polished Steel Grudge-Pen
flavorText: A heavy steel pen, filled with blood and ink. Perfect for correspondence with your most hated enemies.
name: Polished Steel Grudge-Pen

title: Troll-Skin Brooding Sack
flavorText: This small leather sack practically begs to be squeezed. Great for relieving stress and focusing anger.
name: Troll-Skin Brooding Sack

title: Echatere Bullhook
flavorText: A long oaken staff with an ornate bronze hook. The rancher this belonged to must be wealthy indeed.
name: Echatere Bullhook

title: Ornate Defiance-Stone
flavorText: A polished riverstone, covered in threatening motifs. Flinging this at a chief's door can prompt a battle for clan leadership.
name: Ornate Defiance-Stone

title: Tumnosh Lantern
flavorText: This finely-wrought silver lantern was likely used by a wealthy foreman in Graystone Quarry.
name: Tumnosh Lantern

title: Signed Vosh Ball
flavorText: This vosh ball bears the signature of a famous champion—presumably written before his career-ending skull fracture.
name: Signed Vosh Ball

title: Truffle Identification Card
flavorText: This painstakingly researched guide to local truffles is a must-have item for any true Orcish culinarian.
name: Truffle Identification Card

title: Jathsogur Social Club Pin
flavorText: Before falling out with their Wood Orc cousins, visitors from Orsinium received this gold pin depicting a fortress on a hill.
name: Jathsogur Social Club Pin

title: Bloodtusk Centerpiece
flavorText: This lovingly polished centerpiece depicts legendary Orc hero Baloth Bloodtusk slaying the treacherous villain Gaiden Shinji.
name: Bloodtusk Centerpiece

title: Orichalc Kurog Bust
flavorText: A disturbingly accurate bust of the Orc sovereign, King Kurog.
name: Orichalc Kurog Bust

title: Polished Clan Brand
flavorText: This heavy iron brand bears the seal of one of Wrothgar's lesser clans, but the craftsmanship is peerless.
name: Polished Clan Brand

title: Varnished Bone Chimes
flavorText: These suspended ogre-bones have been dyed black and issue ghostly hollow tones when the wind blows.
name: Varnished Bone Chimes

title: Morkul-Forged Tea Kettle
flavorText: This kettle is absurdly heavy and features a series of hard, sharp edges—perfect for making tea or slaying your enemies.
name: Morkul-Forged Tea Kettle

title: Dueling Durzog Candlesticks
flavorText: A pair of silver candlesticks carved to resemble two durzogs at play.
name: Dueling Durzog Candlesticks

title: Ivory Blood Basin
flavorText: The interior of this ivory bowl is stained red by years of heavy use. How the blood was used is anyone's guess.
name: Ivory Blood Basin

title: Embroidered Mudcrab Bib
flavorText: A finely embroidered bib. The stitching depicts a mudcrab being eaten whole by a smiling Orc chef.
name: Embroidered Mudcrab Bib

title: Ash-Hands Battle Wash
flavorText: The water in this glass vessel is black as pitch—used for washing the hands before battle.
name: Ash-Hands Battle Wash

title: Malacath's Wound Paste
flavorText: This foul-smelling black paste burns like fire when applied to old wounds—keeping rage fresh until vengeance is doled out.
name: Malacath's Wound Paste

title: Gilded Drinking Tusk
flavorText: A huge horker tusk, lined in gold and covered in ornate etchings.
name: Gilded Drinking Tusk

title: Ornate Tattoo Kit
flavorText: A well-loved pine box full of tattoo needles, both large and small.
name: Ornate Tattoo Kit

title: Polished Tumnor
flavorText: This stone appears to be an ornate grave marker. Archaeologists or family members would likely pay top coin for it.
name: Polished Tumnor

title: Warpaint Mortar
flavorText: This ancient stone mortar is covered in Orc clan script. It was likely used in the ancient and bloody art of Orc warpaint.
name: Warpaint Mortar

title: Antique Graver
flavorText: This steel engraving tool has maintained its sharpness despite years of heavy use. Malacath's face is hewn into the grip.
name: Antique Graver

title: Cedar Boot Keepers
flavorText: Foot-shaped spring-loaded cedar forms tucked into wet hunting boots, to control odor and help keep their shape.
name: Cedar Boot Keepers

title: Breton Pummel-Doll
flavorText: A young Orc's most beloved toy, this ragged leather doll has been whipped, punched, and stabbed repeatedly.
name: Breton Pummel-Doll

title: Loon-Down Throw Pillow
flavorText: This pillow is filled with genuine chub loon down. One side bears Trinimac's visage, stitched in white lace.
name: Loon-Down Throw Pillow

title: Lavender Helm-Freshener
flavorText: A supple leather pouch filled with aromatic lavender and exotic spices. A perfect remedy for the smelliest headwear.
name: Lavender Helm-Freshener

title: Heavy Bronze Nose-Ring
flavorText: This fine bronze jewelry is remarkably heavy. The nose that once bore it might be difficult to look at.
name: Heavy Bronze Nose-Ring

title: Fine Leather Tooth-Purse
flavorText: This fine silken purse contains a handful of tusks and molars—likely extracted as part of a blood price.
name: Fine Leather Tooth-Purse

title: Fine Tusk Wax
flavorText: According to the bottle, "Uncle Boorg's Tusk-Shine" will make your tusks shine brighter and bite harder.
name: Fine Tusk Wax

title: Ornate Ashwood Switch
flavorText: This beautifully carved switch is the work of a master woodworker. Guaranteed to tame even the most unruly youth.
name: Ornate Ashwood Switch

title: Vosh Rakh Initiation Kerchief
flavorText: This once golden sash is coated with dried blood. The old runes stitched upon it suggest it is used for initiation rituals.
name: Vosh Rakh Initiation Kerchief

title: Stainless Dueling Jock
flavorText: A sturdy steel jock for protecting one's most valuable assets in an Orsinium street-duel.
name: Stainless Dueling Jock

title: Ivory Earplugs
flavorText: A pair of durzog fangs carved and sanded to function as earplugs. These are no doubt an annoyed spouse's prized possessions.
name: Ivory Earplugs

title: Lacquered Malacath Totem
flavorText: This stone totem is disturbing to behold. Malacath's gruesome features are dyed a rusty brown by repeated applications of blood.
name: Lacquered Malacath Totem

title: Polished Sleeping Stone
flavorText: This huge polished river stone functions as a traditional Orc pillow. Once common, they've become collector's items.
name: Polished Sleeping Stone

title: Scented Hair Oil
flavorText: This thick black oil smells of woodsmoke and lavender. "The aromatic combination to drive Orcs wild!" claims the label.
name: Scented Hair Oil

title: "A Forge-Mother's Wisdom," 1st Edition
flavorText: A picture book of affirmations and avenged transgressions by Forge-Mother Targak. Reprints are wildly popular in recent years.
name: "A Forge-Mother's Wisdom," 1st Edition

title: Old Orsinium Coins
flavorText: A small pouch of rare and valuable coins minted in the furnaces of the old Orsinium, in the First Era.
name: Old Orsinium Coins

title: Code of Malacath Paperweight
flavorText: A medium-sized paperweight carved from obsidian stone, inscribed with the traditional Code of Malacath.
name: Code of Malacath Paperweight

title: Commemorative Whiskey Flask
flavorText: A silver flask inscribed with a likeness of the "Old Kindlepitch Whiskey" label, commemorating the product's 200th anniversary.
name: Commemorative Whiskey Flask

title: Bone-Handled Grooming Kit
flavorText: A kit of Orcish bone-handled grooming tools, including toenail clippers, a mustache comb, an earwax remover, and a tusk file.
name: Bone-Handled Grooming Kit

title: Weighted Gambling Dice
flavorText: Gambling dice carved from horker ivory, weighted so that they always come up "double skulls."
name: Weighted Gambling Dice

title: Orsinium's Remembrance War Drum
flavorText: A small, finely-crafted war drum of polished wood with an elk skin drumhead, dating back to the First Era.
name: Orsinium's Remembrance War Drum

title: Brass Mess Kit
flavorText: A well-made mess kit of polished brass, inscribed with the emblem of Shatul clan.
name: Brass Mess Kit

title: Bearskin Bedroll
flavorText: A beautifully-crafted bedroll of soft, white fur made from snow bear hide.
name: Bearskin Bedroll

title: Azurian Caviar Spoon
flavorText: A small silver spoon for serving caviar of the finest Azurian Sturgeon, King Kurog's personal favorite.
name: Azurian Caviar Spoon

title: Crystal Wine Decanter
flavorText: A beautiful wine decanter of cut glass crystal, in the shape of a snowy owl taking flight.
name: Crystal Wine Decanter

title: Morkul Clan Travel Kit
flavorText: A wooden box containing a whetstone, a metal file, a flask of oil, and gritpaper. The box bears the seal of Morkul clan.
name: Morkul Clan Travel Kit

title: Cat-Man Ventriloquist Puppet
flavorText: A popular Orsinium puppet. This mockingly derisive caricature of a Khajiit merchant is used to entertain children.
name: Cat-Man Ventriloquist Puppet

title: Portrait of Yashnag gro-Yazgu
flavorText: A full-color oil painting of the famous Orc warlord, Yashnag gro-Yazgu, set into a gilded frame.
name: Portrait of Yashnag gro-Yazgu

title: Musical Snuff Box
flavorText: A sterling silver snuff box with a wind-up mechanism that plays music when opened.
name: Musical Snuff Box

title: Signed Gulob Stick
flavorText: A wooden cudgel used in the violent sport Gulob. Supposedly signed by the late One-Tooth Skrib, but likely a forgery.
name: Signed Gulob Stick

title: Ladies Durzog Skin Purse
flavorText: A fashionable ladies purse of fine durzog skin, made by the famous clothier Olfim gra-Olfa.
name: Ladies Durzog Skin Purse

title: Spidersilk Sheets
flavorText: A full set of finely-spun spidersilk sheets made to fit a "troll-sized" bed.
name: Spidersilk Sheets

title: Longhouse Play Set
flavorText: A child's dollhouse fashioned to resemble an Orc longhouse, filled with intricately-detailed miniature furniture.
name: Longhouse Play Set

title: Bone Porcelain Tea Service
flavorText: A set of four cups and saucers with a matching tea kettle, made from fine porcelain composed of bone ash, clay, and feldspar.
name: Bone Porcelain Tea Service

title: Hearth-Wife Doll
flavorText: A beautifully made child's doll, made to look like a smiling, rosy-cheeked Orc Hearth-Wife.
name: Hearth-Wife Doll

title: Giant Snow Bear Rug
flavorText: A fluffy, white bearskin rug. Made from a particularly large snow bear found in the farthest northern reaches of Wrothgar.
name: Giant Snow Bear Rug

title: Fox Fur Gutcatcher
flavorText: A mid-length, silk-lined hunting blanket made from the finest red fox fur, used to catch gore when gutting a caught fox.
name: Fox Fur Gutcatcher

title: Copper Censer
flavorText: A finely-wrought copper vessel made for burning incense, with images of Malacath inlaid in the surface.
name: Copper Censer

title: Morkul Clan Banner
flavorText: A banner bearing the seal of Clan Morkul, made from fine spun spidersilk.
name: Morkul Clan Banner

title: Riddle'Thar's Box of Pranks
flavorText: A wooden box containing an assortment of joke and prank items, imported from the far-off markets of Elsweyr.
name: Riddle'Thar's Box of Pranks

title: Malacath's Brass Arse Warmer
flavorText: A flat brass pan with a perforated lid bearing the angry visage of Malacath. Filled with hot coals, it can warm beds or chairs.
name: Malacath's Brass Arse Warmer

title: Stuffed Albino Chub Loon
flavorText: An extremely rare albino chub loon, stuffed and mounted for display.
name: Stuffed Albino Chub Loon

title: Antique Spyglass
flavorText: A very old hand-tooled spyglass, dating back to the time of Old Orsinium.
name: Antique Spyglass

title: Enchanted Handwarmer
flavorText: A sealed metal container inside a small velvet bag, enchanted to continuously give off heat without burning any fuel.
name: Enchanted Handwarmer

title: House Cricket Cage
flavorText: A small cage made from fine silver wire, intended to contain a small house cricket—considered good luck in Orsinium.
name: House Cricket Cage

title: Carved Onion Flute
flavorText: An instrument called a "kazoo" that adds a buzzing, timbral quality to one's voice. Also known as a "misery whistle."
name: Carved Onion Flute

title: Hand-Knitted Woolen Scarf
flavorText: An impractically long, hand-knitted, absurdly multi-coloured scarf. Sold primarily to foreigners in Orsinium.
name: Hand-Knitted Woolen Scarf

title: Fox Fur Ear Muffs
flavorText: A beautifully-made pair of fox fur ear muffs, perfect for winter hunting expeditions.
name: Fox Fur Ear Muffs

title: Murtag Clan Tacklebox
flavorText: This tacklebox of carved wood contains an entire set of hand-made fishing lures. The mark of Murtag clan is burned into the top.
name: Murtag Clan Tacklebox

title: Shatul Clan Echatere Paint
flavorText: A complete set of unused echatere paint in the distinctive color palette of Shatul clan.
name: Shatul Clan Echatere Paint

title: Dreamweaver Wisp Mobile
flavorText: A hanging sculpture of blown glass with small wisps trapped inside. Its dazzling light is said to foster pleasant dreams.
name: Dreamweaver Wisp Mobile

title: "Orc-cordian" Squeeze Box
flavorText: A bellows-driven musical instrument popular among the various Orc clans of Wrothgar.
name: "Orc-cordian" Squeeze Box

title: Ornate Diagna Banner
flavorText: This bright blue banner is tattered and threadbare, but definitely authentic—a battle flag for the ancient Order of Diagna.
name: Ornate Diagna Banner

title: Silver Nosehair Clippers
flavorText: Long, thin, sterling silver scissors used for grooming unsightly nose hair. The same brand preferred by King Kurog.
name: Silver Nosehair Clippers

title: Harpy Feather Calligraphy Set
flavorText: A set of exquisite calligraphy pens fashioned from harpy feathers with an assortment of multi-colored inks.
name: Harpy Feather Calligraphy Set

title: Hearth-Wife's Hand Mirror
flavorText: This hand mirror has a dark mahogany handle inlaid with semi-precious stones and gold filigree.
name: Hearth-Wife's Hand Mirror

title: Gilded Trinimac Parchment Weight
flavorText: When the cold Wrothgar winds blow, this heavy statuette of Trinimac keeps papers and parchment on the desk.
name: Gilded Trinimac Parchment Weight

title: Bottle of Imported Abecean Ink
flavorText: Squid ink of deepest black, imported from the far-off Abecean Sea, in an ornamental broad-bottomed bottle.
name: Bottle of Imported Abecean Ink

title: Snow Harpy-Feather Writing Quill
flavorText: Exotic writing quill with a silver nib crafted from a long white snow harpy flight feather.
name: Snow Harpy-Feather Writing Quill

title: Pocket Mammoth Snow Globe
flavorText: Shake this glass snow globe to see its adorable baby pocket mammoth in a blizzard of fine flakes.
name: Pocket Mammoth Snow Globe

title: Silver Butcher-Knife Letter Opener
flavorText: Fancy letter opener shaped like a miniature butcher knife, wrought in fine silver and engraved, "Compliments of Ragbarlag."
name: Silver Butcher-Knife Letter Opener

title: Intricate Clockwork Snowy Owl
flavorText: Windup brass and ceramic snowy owl that turns its head, blinks, and hoots raspily. Imported from Necrom.
name: Intricate Clockwork Snowy Owl

title: Ivory Horker's-Head Bottle Opener
flavorText: Ornate mammoth-ivory bottle opener carved to look like a horker's head, with metal tusks for prying off bottle caps.
name: Ivory Horker's-Head Bottle Opener

title: Gem-Studded Bear Mount Bridle
flavorText: Dress bridle of echatere-leather studded with small precious stones, as issued to the Royal Orsinium Bear Cavalry.
name: Gem-Studded Bear Mount Bridle

title: Presentation Set of Sharpening Stones
flavorText: Three sharpening stones of different density and coarseness in a jadeite presentation box, engraved "Morkul Forge."
name: Presentation Set of Sharpening Stones

title: Gilt Malacath Travel Icon
flavorText: Folding diptych containing a gold-foil icon of Malacath, used by the devout as a prayer-object when traveling.
name: Gilt Malacath Travel Icon

title: Orsinium Crest Orichalc Clippers
flavorText: Heavy-duty orichalc-alloy nail clippers, for use on bear or echatere claws, engraved with the Royal Orsinium Crest.
name: Orsinium Crest Orichalc Clippers

title: Silver Mirror with Ivory Handle
flavorText: Opulent silvered hand mirror with a mammoth-ivory handle, in a padded oiled-mammoth-leather travel case.
name: Silver Mirror with Ivory Handle

title: Alabaster Bust of King Golkarr
flavorText: Hand-sculpted alabaster bust of King Golkarr, who ruled Orsinium during the legendary thirty-year siege.
name: Alabaster Bust of King Golkarr

title: Horker-Toss Prize Plaque
flavorText: Nice imported mahogany plaque with mounted horker tusk, inscribed "Runner-Up, Frostbreak Fort Horker Toss."
name: Horker-Toss Prize Plaque

title: Rose Quartz Gambling Dice
flavorText: Pair of over-sized rose quartz dice with onyx pips, in a leather dice cup engraved "The Greedy Gut Tavern."
name: Rose Quartz Gambling Dice

title: Commemorative Ale Tankard
flavorText: Two-pint lacquered ale tankard with golden crown-shaped lid, painted "Kurog's Coronation" in bright gold letters.
name: Commemorative Ale Tankard

title: Precious Stone "Payback" Game Set
flavorText: Oak folding board for the Orcish "Payback" game, with oaken box containing 32 pawns, 16 onyx and 16 moonstone.
name: Precious Stone "Payback" Game Set

title: Judicial Blood Price Gold Scale
flavorText: Scale for weighing out blood price amounts, with different gold weights labeled "Chief," "Wife," and "Warrior."
name: Judicial Blood Price Gold Scale

title: Orsinium Seal Shaved-Ice Cups
flavorText: Set of four cut-glass shaved-ice cups, each bearing the Royal Seal of Orsinium.
name: Orsinium Seal Shaved-Ice Cups

title: Fancy Filigreed Spice Rack
flavorText: Spice rack of filigreed copper tracery containing blown-glass bottles, labeled "Chef Obgurob's Selection."
name: Fancy Filigreed Spice Rack

title: Ornamental Skull Beer Stein
flavorText: Beer stein made of a sawed-off silver-chased human skull; the handle is a dagger haft with a turquoise pommel.
name: Ornamental Skull Beer Stein

title: Set of Snow Ogre Nail Spoons
flavorText: Splendid gift set of eight gilt spoons with scrimshaw handles, the bowls crafted from snow ogre fingernails.
name: Set of Snow Ogre Nail Spoons

title: Silver-Plated Baby Shoes
flavorText: A pair of silver-plated miniature sabatons, labeled "Baby's First Steel-Plated Footies."
name: Silver-Plated Baby Shoes

title: Begemmed Egg Timer
flavorText: Exquisite gem-encrusted time-glass set for five minutes, the time it takes to hardboil a chub loon egg.
name: Begemmed Egg Timer

title: "Malacath's Vengeance" Tapestry
flavorText: Rolled-up tapestry of fine silk depicting the giant Orc-Father crushing Breton and Redguard soldiers underfoot.
name: "Malacath's Vengeance" Tapestry

title: Miniature Elk-Antler Castanets
flavorText: A miniature pair of silver elk antler castanets to be slipped on thumb and finger, for the Hunt-Wife's Dance.
name: Miniature Elk-Antler Castanets

title: Bretonball Victory Plaque
flavorText: Wall plaque with two crossed and gilded Bretonball rackets, with a metal plate engraved "Most Valuable Thwacker."
name: Bretonball Victory Plaque

title: Commemorative Ice Axe
flavorText: Ornamental ice axe with mammoth-ivory handle, inscribed "Glacier Days 577." Includes pair of wall-mount hooks.
name: Commemorative Ice Axe

title: Royal Orsinium Cavalry Bugle
flavorText: Parade dress bugle with silk hanging pennant displaying the Orsinium Royal Seal, as used by the Bear Cavalry.
name: Royal Orsinium Cavalry Bugle

title: Looted Redguard Battle Flag
flavorText: Folded battle flag of the First Ska'vyn Camel Scouts, torn in three places and spotted with blood.
name: Looted Redguard Battle Flag

title: Fine Patterned Winter Blanket
flavorText: Romantic winter blanket of echatere cashmere, patterned with red hearts intertwined with the word "REVENGE."
name: Fine Patterned Winter Blanket

title: Sumptuous Fertility Pillow
flavorText: Chub loon-feather pillow encased in tanned topgrain snow ogre hide, embroidered in silverthread with fertility symbols.
name: Sumptuous Fertility Pillow

title: Poseable Stuffed Riekr Mannequin
flavorText: Fine taxidermied Riekr skin mounted on a fully-poseable articulated mannequin, usable as hat stand, coat tree, or knife target.
name: Poseable Stuffed Riekr Mannequin

title: Gold-Leaf Trinimac Worship-Plaque
flavorText: Trinimac worshiper's gold-leaf god mask, mounted to a plaque dedicating the Feast of the Immortal Subterfuge.
name: Gold-Leaf Trinimac Worship-Plaque

title: Snow Harpy Masquerade Wings
flavorText: Scrupulously-preserved pair of snow harpy wings attached to a feather-covered leather harness with adjustable straps.
name: Snow Harpy Masquerade Wings

title: Orsimer Enemies Ear Collection
flavorText: Display board mounted with 28 preserved ears from Breton, Redguard, and Reachman warriors; formerly hung on the wall.
name: Orsimer Enemies Ear Collection

title: "Orcish Intimacy" Tusk Sheaths
flavorText: Pair of elegant tusk sheaths, padded and rounded, of the finest topgrain horker hide, oiled for softness.
name: "Orcish Intimacy" Tusk Sheaths

title: Echatere Cashmere Sleeping Mask
flavorText: Opaque sleeping mask lined with luxuriously soft echatere cashmere, labeled "North Coast Furriers."
name: Echatere Cashmere Sleeping Mask

title: "Hooting Lullaby" Ocarina
flavorText: Exquisite ceramic ocarina in the shape of a snowy owl; it plays with a gentle, resonant hooting tone.
name: "Hooting Lullaby" Ocarina

title: Four Luxurious Flipper Mittens
flavorText: Two pairs of flawless fur-lined flipper mittens with golden wrist grommets, for playing "The Burrowing Horkers."
name: Four Luxurious Flipper Mittens

title: Skating Chub Loon Music Box
flavorText: Unique glass-topped music box: a tiny chub loon skates across its surface while the clockwork plays "Arctic Zephyrs."
name: Skating Chub Loon Music Box

title: Bejeweled Bear Fat Applicator
flavorText: Antique silver-cylindered bear fat applicator, with an emerald-spangled plunger handle.
name: Bejeweled Bear Fat Applicator

title: Imperial City Gear
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of equipment from the Imperial City.
name: Imperial City Gear

title: CRAFTED: Law of Julianos
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Law of Julianos item set.
name: CRAFTED: Law of Julianos

title: CRAFTED: Trial by Fire
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Trial by Fire item set.
name: CRAFTED: Trial by Fire

title: CRAFTED: Morkuldin
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Morkuldin item set.
name: CRAFTED: Morkuldin

title: Heavy: Mark of the Pariah
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Mark of the Pariah item set.
name: Heavy: Mark of the Pariah

title: Light: Trinimac's Valor
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Trinimac's Valor item set.
name: Light: Trinimac's Valor

title: Medium: Briarheart
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Briarheart item set.
name: Medium: Briarheart

title: Heavy: Permafrost
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Permafrost item set.
name: Heavy: Permafrost

title: Heavy: Glorious Defender
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Glorious Defender item set.
name: Heavy: Glorious Defender

title: Medium: Para Bellum
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Para Bellum item set.
name: Medium: Para Bellum

title: Light: Elemental Succession
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Elemental Succession item set.
name: Light: Elemental Succession

title: Medium: Hunt Leader
flavorText: This box contains a full suite of Infused, Legendary-quality, CR 160 equipment, of the Hunt Leader item set.
name: Medium: Hunt Leader

title: Light: Winterborn

title: Tuneless Harp of Fiirgarion the Bard
flavorText: Given to Fiirgarion at a rigged competition for best entertainer in Valenwood, where he famously took first prize. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Tuneless Harp of Fiirgarion the Bard

title: Hairball Spittoon of Darloc Brae
flavorText: Kept handy for the Golden Beast for his post-battle grooming rituals. It has a faint acrid smell.  NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Hairball Spittoon of Darloc Brae

title: Burial Mannequin of Calarthor Camoran
flavorText: Made to stand in for Calarthor's body, lost in the fight against the Colovians, but unused when he turned up lost in the woods. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Burial Mannequin of Calarthor Camoran

title: Divad Hunding's Dribble Bowl
flavorText: Allegedly held under Divad Hunding's chin by an attendant as he quenched his fierce desert thirst. Stained with wine, or blood. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Divad Hunding's Dribble Bowl

title: King Farangel's Unpublished Ode to Wayrest
flavorText: The disjointed scribblings of an epic ballad about the beauty and wonder of Wayrest, purportedly penned by the king himself. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: King Farangel's Unpublished Ode to Wayrest

title: Yokeda Sesnit's Paperweights
flavorText: These were vital to preventing the vast inventories of the Elden Yokeda's conquests from spilling about his chambers. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Yokeda Sesnit's Paperweights

title: Raven Direnni's Inflammable Rug
flavorText: Purportedly one of the first magical items created after the famed mage discovered the principles of enchantment. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Raven Direnni's Inflammable Rug

title: Princess Rayelle's Half-hearted Love Letters
flavorText: Unenthusiastic overtures to King Emeric's good looks and virility, written at the behest of her father. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Princess Rayelle's Half-hearted Love Letters

title: King Jorunn's Automatic Cheesewheel Vivisector
flavorText: This Dwarven crescent blade is the central component of Skyrim's one and only machine powered cheese slicer. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: King Jorunn's Automatic Cheesewheel Vivisector

title: Akaviri Armistice Banquet Tray
flavorText: Fashioned from armaments in a symbolic gesture of peace, it spilled enough drinks at the Grand Moot to nearly dissolve the pact. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Akaviri Armistice Banquet Tray

title: Shaman Chirah's Devotion Shovel
flavorText: Believed to be a blessed instrument of Z'en, the Kothringi christened many endeavors by breaking ground with this shovel. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Shaman Chirah's Devotion Shovel

title: King Dumac's Royal Latrine Cloth Roll
flavorText: Originally believed to be a banner of the Dwarven royal house of Red Mountain, it was taken down after the error was discovered. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: King Dumac's Royal Latrine Cloth Roll

title: Ysgramor's Sload-skin Wine Sack
flavorText: Slick and elastic, this wine sack can distend to many times it original volume. Few can stomach using it, for many reasons. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Ysgramor's Sload-skin Wine Sack

title: Prince Hubalajad's Trash Urn
flavorText: The prince's funerary urn became the final place of rest for letters about his unpaid debts in the failing years of his legacy. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Prince Hubalajad's Trash Urn

title: Treethane Niriel's "Living Plant-Wear" Book Set
flavorText: "Flourish with a Flourish," foremost authority on Bosmer zoetic fashion, inscribed on live flora. This printing has dried out. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Treethane Niriel's "Living Plant-Wear" Book Set

title: Coronation Decanter of Prince Naemon
flavorText: Crafted to commemorate Prince Naemon's ascent to the throne. It bears the cracks of a violent impact. NOTE: This item is on Kari's Hit List! Bring it to the Thieves Den and place it in the library to prove you're a Master Thief.
name: Coronation Decanter of Prince Naemon

title: Yokudan Paperweight
flavorText: A heavy piece of carved stonework from a Yokudan ruin, used as a paperweight.
name: Yokudan Paperweight

title: Spotless Goods Signet Stamp
flavorText: A signet stamp bearing the official seal of the Spotless Goods Shipping Concern, highly valued by smugglers and forgers.
name: Spotless Goods Signet Stamp

title: Two-Faced Coin
flavorText: A gold coin bearing a likeness of the Mask of Clavicus Vile on both sides.
name: Two-Faced Coin

title: Shark Tooth Necklace
flavorText: A woman's necklace made from polished shark teeth.
name: Shark Tooth Necklace

title: Child's Wind-Up Toy
flavorText: A tin wind-up toy made to resemble a mechanical Dwemer spider.
name: Child's Wind-Up Toy

title: Bookbinding Kit
flavorText: A set of tools and materials used for repairing or replacing the leather covers of worn books.
name: Bookbinding Kit

title: Maormer Spyglass
flavorText: A brass spyglass engraved with a raunchy Maormer limerick.
name: Maormer Spyglass

title: Wooden Dragonfrog Carving
flavorText: An excellent likeness of a dragon frog carved from a single piece of orange ironwood.
name: Wooden Dragonfrog Carving

title: Senche Tigerskin Bedroll
flavorText: The skin of a senche-tiger with a sewn-in silk lining, used as a bedroll in the wilderness.
name: Senche Tigerskin Bedroll

title: Copper Mess Kit
flavorText: A well made, hinged hunter's mess kit of polished copper.
name: Copper Mess Kit

title: Chukoo Bones
flavorText: A set of carved and brightly painted animal bones, used for the popular fortune-telling game Chukoo.
name: Chukoo Bones

title: Spidersilk Ladies Scarf
flavorText: A ladies scarf made of fine-spun spidersilk, with silver thread filigree.
name: Spidersilk Ladies Scarf

title: Haj Mota Jelly Curative
flavorText: Jelly made by boiling haj mota shells. Believed to flush toxins from the body and cure acne and insomnia.
name: Haj Mota Jelly Curative

title: Minstrel's Uka-Lute
flavorText: A miniature, playable stringed lute of lacquered wood, favored by wandering minstrels for its portability.
name: Minstrel's Uka-Lute

title: Fend-Em-Off Insect Repellent
flavorText: A bottle of extremely potent insect repellent. The label claims, "Keeps even kotu gava away for hours!"
name: Fend-Em-Off Insect Repellent

title: Ship's Signal Lantern
flavorText: A brass-and-glass ship's lantern fitted with a set of hinged shutters, used for ship-to-ship communication at sea.
name: Ship's Signal Lantern

title: Silk Parasol
flavorText: A brightly-colored sun parasol made from embroidered silk.
name: Silk Parasol

title: Privacy Disc
flavorText: A disc of leather with attached stick. Hold to cover the mouth, preventing the lip-reading of private conversations.
name: Privacy Disc

title: Document Forging Kit
flavorText: A velvet-lined wooden box containing various inks, writing implements, seals, and official-looking stamps.
name: Document Forging Kit

title: Eavesdropping Earhorn
flavorText: A brass horn with a sound-amplifying membrane, designed to be pressed against a wall or door to eavesdrop on conversations.
name: Eavesdropping Earhorn

title: Brass Monkey
flavorText: A rather macabre "good luck" idol, made by encasing the corpse of a real monkey in brass.
name: Brass Monkey

title: Daedric Playing Cards
flavorText: A set of hand-painted playing cards with trumps made to look like Daedric Princes.
name: Daedric Playing Cards

title: Carved Wooden Leg
flavorText: A fancy prosthetic peg-leg carved from mahogany and inset with small gems.
name: Carved Wooden Leg

title: Mudcrab Cracker Set
flavorText: A set of silver crab crackers, essential for getting to the meat of a mudcrab quickly and easily.
name: Mudcrab Cracker Set

title: Maormer Slave Manacles
flavorText: Iron Manacles of the type used by Maormer slave traders.
name: Maormer Slave Manacles

title: Morag Tong Interrogation Kit
flavorText: A leather satchel bearing the symbol of the Morag Tong, containing devices like thumbscrews and sharp implements.
name: Morag Tong Interrogation Kit

title: Honeysap Everchew Treats
flavorText: An imported package of chewing gum made from the rare and tasty moon-sugar honeysap of Elsweyr.
name: Honeysap Everchew Treats

title: Shorty Shalum's Height Enhancers
flavorText: A pair of carved wooden wedges designed to be inserted into shoes, subtly increasing the wearer's apparent height.
name: Shorty Shalum's Height Enhancers

title: Pacrooti's Mole Asses
flavorText: A jug of a peculiar and popular brand of molasses, bottled and sold by an enterprising young Khajiit.
name: Pacrooti's Mole Asses

title: Pirate Ship Model
flavorText: Its brass nameplate identifies this intricately-detailed model of a Maormer pirate vessel "The Wandering Gale."
name: Pirate Ship Model

title: Ship's Cargo Net
flavorText: A finely-woven cargo net folded inside a canvas bag, apparently never used.
name: Ship's Cargo Net

title: Prince Hubalajad Tapestry
flavorText: A colorful woven tapestry depicting Prince Hubalajad, the founder of Abah's Landing.
name: Prince Hubalajad Tapestry

title: Wooden Juggling Clubs
flavorText: A set of three lacquered wooden clubs or batons, commonly used by street performers in Abah's Landing.
name: Wooden Juggling Clubs

title: Gilded Vanity Mirror
flavorText: A fine silver vanity mirror, set into a gilded frame.
name: Gilded Vanity Mirror

title: "Battle On The High Seas" Game
flavorText: A game of ship-to-ship pirate battles played using wooden pegs, strategically placed on a peg board.
name: "Battle On The High Seas" Game

title: Scrimshander's Dice Cup
flavorText: An ornate dice casting cup carved from a single piece of whale bone.
name: Scrimshander's Dice Cup

title: Incriminating Correspondence
flavorText: One merchant's letter to another, containing incriminating evidence of cargo smuggling.
name: Incriminating Correspondence

title: Hand-Crafted Cornett
flavorText: A conical wooden wind instrument, covered in leather, with finger holes and a small ivory mouthpiece.
name: Hand-Crafted Cornett

title: Silver Toenail Clippers
flavorText: A pair of sterling silver toenail clippers inscribed with the owner's initials.
name: Silver Toenail Clippers

title: Brass Duck Call
flavorText: A brass whistle on a chain, made to emulate the sound of a duck, used by hunters.
name: Brass Duck Call

title: The Rid-Thar's Moon Pearls
flavorText: Moon Pearls are considered sacred, often displayed behind the altars of the greatest Temples of the Two-Moons Dance. This pair is said to have been blessed by the prophet Rid-Thar-ri'Datta himself.
name: The Rid-Thar's Moon Pearls

title: Royal Redtail Hawk Writing Quill
flavorText: Feather from a redtail hawk, sacred to Tava, fashioned into a writing quill with a golden nib. Reserved for use by the nobility.
name: Royal Redtail Hawk Writing Quill

title: Turquoise Dragon Frog Paperweight
flavorText: Paperweight of a dragon frog carved from a huge nugget of turquoise, with "No Shira Citadel" engraved on the bottom.
name: Turquoise Dragon Frog Paperweight

title: Prince Hew's Haj Mota Toupee
flavorText: Recreation of Hubalajad's haj mota-shaped toupee, including the original emerald eyes, mounted on a half-bust of the late noble.
name: Prince Hew's Haj Mota Toupee

title: Gilded Toku Gava Ink Pen
flavorText: A golden pen in the shape of a giant mosquito; the scrivener holds the thorax and writes with the proboscis.
name: Gilded Toku Gava Ink Pen

title: Gurges and Associates Silver Keychain
flavorText: Finely-wrought silver keychain with a crystal fob. Etched with the seal of Gurges and Associates, the "fallen house."
name: Gurges and Associates Silver Keychain

title: Ra Gada Style Platinum Pen Knife
flavorText: Folding pen knife with platinum handle, wrought in the Ra Gada style of the second, or Tavan wave of settlers.
name: Ra Gada Style Platinum Pen Knife

title: Hubalajad Jackal Collar
flavorText: Collar for one of Prince Hubalajad's notorious pack of hunting jackals, which turned on and devoured their own trainer.
name: Hubalajad Jackal Collar

title: Ra Gada Lodestone Compass
flavorText: Vintage antique, a compass from one of the fifty-six ships of the second, or Tavan wave of Ra Gada settlers.
name: Ra Gada Lodestone Compass

title: Platinum Yokudan "Sad Duck" Whistle
flavorText: Platinum-chased slide whistle used to mock the overcautious by playing a sad, descending string of notes in a minor key.
name: Platinum Yokudan "Sad Duck" Whistle

title: Noble's Cloth-of-Gold Book Protector
flavorText: Elaborately-embroidered cloth-of-gold book bag, made to carry a noble's copy of the Book of Circles.
name: Noble's Cloth-of-Gold Book Protector

title: Silver "Tears of Zeht" Canteen-Flask
flavorText: Silver teardrop-shaped pouch flask for a Redguard priest, embossed with "Tears of Zeht," though rarely used to contain water.
name: Silver "Tears of Zeht" Canteen-Flask

title: Orichalc Diagna Statuette
flavorText: Orichalc statuette of Diagna, God of the Sideways Blade, holding a severed head, an ancient work clearly Yokudan in origin.
name: Orichalc Diagna Statuette

title: Magnifico's Ivory Hammergammon Set
flavorText: The Magnifico Z'za's folding hammergammon board of precious wood inlays, with ivory pieces and jade multiplier die.
name: Magnifico's Ivory Hammergammon Set

title: "Flaming Ways" Commemorative Plate
flavorText: Gold plate commemorating Prince Hubalajad's accidental burning of the Abah's Landing shipyard.
name: "Flaming Ways" Commemorative Plate

title: Clockwork Dragon Frog Firestarter
flavorText: Antique First-Era noble's novelty device, a clockwork dragon frog that spits a small puff of flame.
name: Clockwork Dragon Frog Firestarter

title: Grandee's Alabaster Auspice Ibis
flavorText: Alabaster statuette of a sacred ibis, hinged at the hips, said to lean forward to give a favorable answer to a question.
name: Grandee's Alabaster Auspice Ibis

title: Hel Shira's Fancy Camel Goad
flavorText: Sword noble's jewel-encrusted camel goad, used when mounted and in full dress uniform for special occasions.
name: Hel Shira's Fancy Camel Goad

title: Princess Zoon'da's Golden Cuff
flavorText: A leather cuff with embroidered swirls once worn by Hubalajad's eldest daughter, stolen and then reclaimed in a famous tale.
name: Princess Zoon'da's Golden Cuff

title: Silver "Lady Morwha" Teaspoon Set
flavorText: Set of ornate silver teaspoons honoring Morwha, goddess of love and fertility, one spoon for each of her four breasts.
name: Silver "Lady Morwha" Teaspoon Set

title: Golden Sep Adder Candlesticks
flavorText: Pair of gold candlesticks wrought in the form of rearing sep adders, wings spread and fanged mouths open.
name: Golden Sep Adder Candlesticks

title: Platinum "Camel Wedding" Platter
flavorText: Painted platinum platter depicting Hubalajad symbolically claiming his peninsula by marrying a sacred white camel.
name: Platinum "Camel Wedding" Platter

title: Silver Royal Taneth Hand Mirror
flavorText: Silver and glass hand mirror with the royal seal of Taneth embossed on the back.
name: Silver Royal Taneth Hand Mirror

title: Baby Haj Mota Snuff Box
flavorText: A filigreed snuff box made from the shell of an infant haj mota.
name: Baby Haj Mota Snuff Box

title: Golden Lawn Bowling Trophy
flavorText: Golden trophy, a hawk's talon holding a "jack" ball engraved "Abah's Landing Bowls Champion, Mid-Year 541."
name: Golden Lawn Bowling Trophy

title: Prince Hew's Gold Swim Weights
flavorText: Prince Hubalajad vowed to strengthen his muscles by swimming in Abah's harbor wearing these golden weights. Used once.
name: Prince Hew's Gold Swim Weights

title: Lacquered Foot Bath
flavorText: Gilded lacquered tray used to soak sore feet in salted waters.
name: Lacquered Foot Bath

title: Mounted Extinct Flightless Bird
flavorText: Rare taxidermied example of the now-extinct gooblet, a flightless bird that lived along the Hammerfell coast before the Ra Gada.
name: Mounted Extinct Flightless Bird

title: Gem-Encrusted Philosophy Skull
flavorText: Exquisite memento mori, a desk or office skull to remind one to do honor to Ruptga every day, for life is short.
name: Gem-Encrusted Philosophy Skull

title: Gold-Tipped Obsidian Dowsing Wand
flavorText: Dowsing wand, reputedly magical, sold to Prince Hew as an infallible guide to a fountain of immortality elixir. Used once.
name: Gold-Tipped Obsidian Dowsing Wand

title: Hilarious Lodestone Bowling Balls
flavorText: Metallic balls for can't-fail lawn bowling made for Prince Hew from lodestones. Used once.
name: Hilarious Lodestone Bowling Balls

title: Silvered Zither with Matching Blindfold
flavorText: Black silver-stringed zither with silver soundbox edging, with matching blindfold to maintain the Prince's privacy.
name: Silvered Zither with Matching Blindfold

title: Seven Pairs of Golden Toebells
flavorText: Seven different pairs of finely-wrought golden bells, one for each week day, for attaching to curly-toed slippers.
name: Seven Pairs of Golden Toebells

title: Prince Hulajabad's Double Bosoms
flavorText: Two-bosom harness worn by Prince Hew in the title role for the play "Lady Morwha's Latest Marriage." Used once.
name: Prince Hulajabad's Double Bosoms

title: Iridescent Boneshaver Cloak
flavorText: Magnificent cloak of iridescent gooblet feathers worn by a priest of Onsi during Boneshaver's Sword Banquet.
name: Iridescent Boneshaver Cloak

title: Gold-Foil Tavan Back Banners
flavorText: Antique First-Era "Tavan Wings" back banners, of gold foil mounted on a structure of ductile copper.
name: Gold-Foil Tavan Back Banners

title: Oversized Tu'whacca Mask
flavorText: Elaborate, oversized ibis-head mask with emerald eyes, worn by a priest of Tu'whacca in the March of Wisdom.
name: Oversized Tu'whacca Mask

title: Ornate Spring-Wound Alarm Clock
flavorText: Wind-up device keeps time for twelve hours, can be set to ring at a certain hour. Inscribed "Imported by Tall Papa's Hoard."
name: Ornate Spring-Wound Alarm Clock

title: Jar of Golden Kohl Eye Shadow
flavorText: Jar of exotic eye shadow, a light-colored kohl containing flecks of actual gold, worn on holidays by grandeyas and magnificas.
name: Jar of Golden Kohl Eye Shadow

title: Prince Hew's Prismatic Sleep Mask
flavorText: Dream-catcher eye mask made from thousands of tiny crystal prisms, intended to catch and preserve dream images. Used once.
name: Prince Hew's Prismatic Sleep Mask

title: Ivory-Handled Gooblet Cat Toy
flavorText: Ornate cat toy, a string of feathers from the extinct gooblet bird hung from an elaborately hand-carved ivory wand.
name: Ivory-Handled Gooblet Cat Toy

title: Jadeite Saint Leki Reliquary
flavorText: Small, exquisitely-carved jadeite box containing a lock of black hair, said to be a relic of Leki the Sword-Saint.
name: Jadeite Saint Leki Reliquary

title: Bottle of Fennec Musk Perfume
flavorText: Crystal bottle of rare and costly fennec musk perfume, very fashionable among the nobility of Gilane, Taneth, and Rihad.
name: Bottle of Fennec Musk Perfume

title: Merchant's Secret Ledger
flavorText: A thinly bound book with a hand-scrawled record of illicit transactions filling the pages.
name: Merchant's Secret Ledger

title: Hagraven Silver-Quill Pen
flavorText: Long and elegant, this hagraven feather has been manicured and inset with silver. It's strong and sharp as a shiv.
name: Hagraven Silver-Quill Pen

title: Bundle of Potential Blackmail
flavorText: A sordid collection of love letters chronicling a torrid extramarital affair.
name: Bundle of Potential Blackmail

title: Blackwater Ink
flavorText: A stoppered flask of thick black fluid that reflects a pearlescent gleam in the light.
name: Blackwater Ink

title: Proof of Pardon
flavorText: A leaf of thick paper stock exonerating the owner of a heinous crime.
name: Proof of Pardon

title: Book of Debtors
flavorText: A meticulously updated record of outstanding loans, annotated with potential collateral and leverage on deadbeat borrowers.
name: Book of Debtors

title: Amber Torchbug Charm
flavorText: A marble of polished amber containing a torchfly. The trapped insect still emits a faint glow in pitch darkness.
name: Amber Torchbug Charm

title: Petrified Dragon Frog
flavorText: Claimed to be the fossil of a dragon frog ensorcelled to adorn the court of Prince Hew. More likely a masterful carving.
name: Petrified Dragon Frog

title: Asp-tongue Knot
flavorText: Two asp's tongues, tied into an intricate knot and dried. Said to ward away poisonous beasts, and liars.
name: Asp-tongue Knot

title: Camel Map of Hew's Bane
flavorText: A hardy rectangle of camel leather with an intricate map of Hew's Bane tattooed into the skin.
name: Camel Map of Hew's Bane

title: Two-Share Tankard
flavorText: A hefty pewter tankard with a hollow grip and concealed mechanism intended to discreetly spike the mug's contents.
name: Two-Share Tankard

title: Wire Weave Rope
flavorText: Sturdy hemp, threaded with spun strands of ebony to fortify it against cutting.
name: Wire Weave Rope

title: Elven Vegetable Peeler
flavorText: An elegant and razor-sharp kitchen utensil. Ruddy stains along the glass blade seem too dark for beets.
name: Elven Vegetable Peeler

title: Game of Glass Jacks
flavorText: At first glance, a harmless game of reflexes, but the pieces are a little too sharp for that to be their intended purpose.
name: Game of Glass Jacks

title: Silver Oyster Fork
flavorText: Thin tines on the end of a wedged handle are meant to split open the boiled delicacies.
name: Silver Oyster Fork

title: Sea's Bounty Bracelet
flavorText: A string of barnacles polished to a sheen and set with perfect ocean pearls.
name: Sea's Bounty Bracelet

title: Elaborate Skooma Pipe
flavorText: This vessel of salvaged Dwemer mechanisms is a small furnace meant to intensify the user's smoking experience.
name: Elaborate Skooma Pipe

title: Ebony Orcish File
flavorText: An implement of Orc craftmanship meant to wear the hardest materials down smooth. Makes a good saw in a pinch.
name: Ebony Orcish File

title: Mudcrab Bowl
flavorText: A large mudcrab shell smoothed down and shaped into dishware. Light, durable, and aesthetically pleasing.
name: Mudcrab Bowl

title: Whiskey Refortifier
flavorText: A divine bouquet of peat and spirits emanate from this empty cask. It is designed to flavor whatever ale is stored within.
name: Whiskey Refortifier

title: Minnow-Tin Scent-Block
flavorText: A tin of deep sea minnow-brine, praised by pearl divers as a shark repellent.
name: Minnow-Tin Scent-Block

title: Mourner's Tumbler
flavorText: A squat crystal drinking glass with the residue of many somber nights being set out and left untouched.
name: Mourner's Tumbler

title: Flint-Steel Finger Caps
flavorText: A pair of snug fitting caps meant for the thumb and middle finger. Great for lighting ovens and party tricks.
name: Flint-Steel Finger Caps

title: Dragon Frog Trivet
flavorText: A taxidermied dragon frog splayed out into a protective pad to place hot cookware upon.
name: Dragon Frog Trivet

title: Empty Ornate Scabbard
flavorText: A beautifully crafted sheath for a dagger, sans the dagger.
name: Empty Ornate Scabbard

title: Cerulean Fountain Spout
flavorText: A smooth colorful ceramic spout from one of Abah's Landing's many fountains.
name: Cerulean Fountain Spout

title: Slaughterfish-tooth Grappel
flavorText: A sinister looking climbing hook made from steel and set with many barbed slaughterfish teeth for grip.
name: Slaughterfish-tooth Grappel

title: Blood Rug
flavorText: Easily washed, stain-proof, and backed in rubber, it'll forget the night before sooner than its owners.
name: Blood Rug

title: Shrunken Claw
flavorText: The grisly paw of a large cat, or possibly a Khajiit, kept with belongings as a ward against burglars.
name: Shrunken Claw

title: Reeking Blanket
flavorText: A light linen cloth enchanted with a potent smell of fermenting fish. A custom's agent's worst enemy.
name: Reeking Blanket

title: Jack of Cork
flavorText: A quilted tube stuffed with a soft buoyant wood. Used to assist with flotation.
name: Jack of Cork

title: Marsh Waders
flavorText: Thick, ugly rubber overalls crafted to keep out bog water and everything living within.
name: Marsh Waders

title: Unwrapped Silk Turban
flavorText: Gossamer fine and threaded with gold, this head wrap would be gorgeous if one knew how to style it.
name: Unwrapped Silk Turban

title: Silk Prick Pocket
flavorText: Pocket-liner meant to be slipped into doublets with large, inviting pockets. The fishhook linings trap incautious pickpockets.
name: Silk Prick Pocket

title: Ornate Prosthetic Hook
flavorText: A sturdy steel hook, to be attached to a vambrace upon the wrist of an amputee. The metalwork is particularly elegant.
name: Ornate Prosthetic Hook

title: Bodice Ripper
flavorText: A concealed razor allegedly invented by a lady of the night, to be sewn into underclothes. Bodices aren't what it rips.
name: Bodice Ripper

title: Opal Snuffbox
flavorText: A small vessel carved out of precious stone. This one appears to be filled with finely ground tobacco.
name: Opal Snuffbox

title: Arkay Votive Figure
flavorText: A tiny statue of the god of the cycle of birth and death, often praised upon rising from slumber for granting another day.
name: Arkay Votive Figure

title: Winsome Welwa Remembrance Pillow
flavorText: A scented pillow gifted to patrons of the Winsome Welwa. A lipstick kiss clings to the fabric.
name: Winsome Welwa Remembrance Pillow

title: Fancy Negligee
flavorText: This lacey bedtime garment hasn't been laundered for some time to preserve its lingering floral scent.
name: Fancy Negligee

title: Illustrated Manual of Hew Coiffuture
flavorText: A faithful, illustrated recreation of Prince Hew's most famed hair styles and, supposedly, steps for their construction.
name: Illustrated Manual of Hew Coiffuture

title: Sugar-Bear Perfume
flavorText: An animal scent mixed with hints of moon-sugar, said to inspire amorous feelings.
name: Sugar-Bear Perfume

title: Three Block Jigsaw Puzzle
flavorText: Barely more challenging than the two block version and too large to choke on.
name: Three Block Jigsaw Puzzle

title: Steel Calipers With Guar-Skin Grip
flavorText: A versatile instrument for measuring thickness. The grip retards heat conduction, allowing for measurements at the forge.
name: Steel Calipers With Guar-Skin Grip

title: Sturdy Awl
flavorText: This spike could probably be driven through iron as easily as the leather it's intended for.
name: Sturdy Awl

title: Shaping Hatchet
flavorText: A small hand ax meant for planing down a log or block of wood before applying more precise tools.
name: Shaping Hatchet

title: Hook Plumb
flavorText: A powerful, finger-sized lodestone on a rope, intended to collect swallowed fish hooks. Works on fish or people.
name: Hook Plumb

title: Glass Hook Case
flavorText: A small leather case containing two dozen elaborate glass fishhooks.
name: Glass Hook Case

title: Rotating Moondial
flavorText: A small cork-infused dial. Placed in water, it spins three times clockwise until it points at the moon Secundus.
name: Rotating Moondial

title: Counter-Rotating Moondial
flavorText: A small cork-infused dial. Placed in water, it spins six times counter-clockwise until it points at the moon Masser.
name: Counter-Rotating Moondial

title: Toothsayer Stone
flavorText: A polished sliver of geode. Placed beneath the tongue, any teeth which will begin to rot within the year emit a faint scream.
name: Toothsayer Stone

title: Illustrated Jeweler's Portfolio
flavorText: A book of colorful illustrations depicting a variety of royal jewelry throughout Tamriel.
name: Illustrated Jeweler's Portfolio

title: Pocket Rules for Kick the Khajiit
flavorText: Kicking is featured prominently, and remains the only consistent feature in an otherwise arbitrary collection of guidelines.
name: Pocket Rules for Kick the Khajiit

title: Cork Discus
flavorText: A lacquered disc of flight-worthy cork popular for water sports.
name: Cork Discus

title: Wax Effigy Candle
flavorText: A fine wax effigy, painted in bright colors, with a small wick protruding from the head.
name: Wax Effigy Candle

title: Used Marbles
flavorText: A set of matching rust-flecked iron marbles. This collection has seen more than a few games, but it's still good.
name: Used Marbles

title: Wooden Hoop
flavorText: A versatile, if simple, tool for the imagination. Toss it, roll it, jump it, juggle it. The possibilities are limitless.
name: Wooden Hoop

title: Safekeeping Doll
flavorText: This lumpy cloth dolly has a split in the seam where its previous owner kept small secret treasures from parents and bullies.
name: Safekeeping Doll

title: Legionnaire Figurine
flavorText: A posable wooden figure of an Imperial soldier complete with tin armor and blunt weaponry.
name: Legionnaire Figurine

title: Slaughterfish Repellent
flavorText: A repugnant slurry of alchemical refuse commonly believed to offer protection from slaughterfish. May be harmful to the user's health.
name: Slaughterfish Repellent

title: Rune Tag
flavorText: A small enchanted piercing applied to throw backs in an attempt to track their schools in following fishing seasons.
name: Rune Tag

title: Coughing Tincture
flavorText: This mixture causes involuntary coughing fits to help expel water from the lungs or prank your friends.
name: Coughing Tincture

title: Hook Sash
flavorText: A leather-backed cloth for keeping fish hooks handy, adjustable to be worn around the body or an appendage.
name: Hook Sash

title: Fishle
flavorText: Tamriel's first and only brand of fish call. Its only saving grace is it makes a useful nautical signal.
name: Fishle

title: Egg Skimmer
flavorText: A downy fine net used for scooping eggs from the shallows of spawning pools.
name: Egg Skimmer

title: Worm Food
flavorText: A rust-proof can of soil and rot meant to sustain bait over a long trek or extended fishing trip.
name: Worm Food

title: 1001 Remedies for Slaughterfish Bites Field Guide
flavorText: Simple illustrations fill this abridged pocket edition. Closer to one hundred.
name: 1001 Remedies for Slaughterfish Bites Field Guide

title: Guar Tallow Candle
flavorText: Fragrant, slow-burning, and found in any town with a guar population.
name: Guar Tallow Candle

title: Recycled Dwarven Lamp
flavorText: This functional lamp was cobbled together from scrap found in Dwemer ruins.
name: Recycled Dwarven Lamp

title: Torchbug Cage
flavorText: An oversized lantern intended as a cozy torchbug nest. Cost effective, but provides barely enough light to read by.
name: Torchbug Cage

title: Sturdy Iron Lantern
flavorText: Excellent for interior lighting and mining operations, but prone to rusting when exposed to the elements.
name: Sturdy Iron Lantern

title: Glow Stick
flavorText: An apprentice magician's enchanted torch. Glows softly so long as a little magicka is supplied.
name: Glow Stick

title: Dirt Magnet
flavorText: A lodestone that gathers all manner of dust and debris when brushed over a surface. Great for cleaning, but a pain to clean.
name: Dirt Magnet

title: Anti-Tumble Tumbler
flavorText: Through some bizarre form of levitation, this glass will never tip without significant force applied. A straw is advised.
name: Anti-Tumble Tumbler

title: Perfect Metronome
flavorText: Once set in motion this device will keep a steady pace until stopped.
name: Perfect Metronome

title: Echo Box
flavorText: A small wooden jewelry box that repeats the last thing whispered into it one more time. Popular among working spouses.
name: Echo Box

title: Transplanting Pot
flavorText: Gnarled wooden pot that seems to breathe a little extra life into a sapling while it awaits a new plot.
name: Transplanting Pot

title: Rash Ointment
flavorText: A jellied paste for soothing irritated skin. The shelf life is astoundingly long.
name: Rash Ointment

title: Corn Pads
flavorText: These little cushions are applied to the skin with resin to mitigate irritation from tight footwear.
name: Corn Pads

title: Hemo-Loam
flavorText: This dusty clay becomes thick and firm when moist, making it well-suited to covering cuts until actual aid can be rendered.
name: Hemo-Loam

title: Joint Hammer
flavorText: A rubber mallet used to crack arthritic joints. Largely considered barbaric and ineffective, it persists as a layman's remedy.
name: Joint Hammer

title: Set of Chisels
flavorText: An assortment of chisels fit to cover most hewing needs.
name: Set of Chisels

title: Ball-peen Hammer
flavorText: Consisting of a traditional flat headed hammer and a rounded peen suited for metal working techniques.
name: Ball-peen Hammer

title: Travel Sewing Kit
flavorText: A compact case with a range of needles and common colored threads at the ready to patch damaged clothing on the road.
name: Travel Sewing Kit

title: Steel Tooling Bits
flavorText: Several styles of bit for a foot-powered auger or drill.
name: Steel Tooling Bits

title: Clothier's Tape
flavorText: A flexible strip of supple leather dyed white and brightly marked for taking measurements.
name: Clothier's Tape

title: Bag of Nails
flavorText: Enough well forged nails to complete an ambitious project or two.
name: Bag of Nails

title: Table Vise
flavorText: Able to be mounted to a work bench and sturdy enough not to lose its grip when force is applied.
name: Table Vise

title: Fish Gut Stink Bag
flavorText: A bag magically treated to reduce odor, currently full of fish effluvia. Occasionally confused by pickpockets for a coin pouch.
name: Fish Gut Stink Bag

title: Crocodile Repellent
flavorText: A tonic that erroneously claims to repel crocodiles. Superstitious fisherfolk sprinkle it on their boots every morning.
name: Crocodile Repellent

title: Warming Waistpouch
flavorText: A pouch attached to smallclothes, intended to hold heated stones. Keeps fisherfolk warm when in waist-high water.
name: Warming Waistpouch

title: Saltwater Taxidermist's Kit
flavorText: A small kit with all the tools needed to mount and display a variety of saltwater dwellers. Plaque not included.
name: Saltwater Taxidermist's Kit

title: Mudcrab Monocle
flavorText: A monocle enchanted to surround any observed mudcrab with a soft, buttery-yellow glow. Does not work at night.
name: Mudcrab Monocle

title: Winter Twaddler's Friend
flavorText: A small copper disc with two thumb holes on opposite sides. Produces a warm sensation when rotated in folded hands.
name: Winter Twaddler's Friend

title: Dwemer Nostril Comb
flavorText: Tiny counter-rotating comb made of dwarven steel. Keeps unkempt nostril hair tidy and luxurious.
name: Dwemer Nostril Comb

title: Soul Gem Waistpocket
flavorText: A detachable waistpocket worn beneath the clothes, intended to keep soul gems from the hands of pickpockets.
name: Soul Gem Waistpocket

title: Corpse Handling Kit
flavorText: A small satchel containing a variety of tools needed to handle and preserve a corpse.
name: Corpse Handling Kit

title: Lacquered Navicula
flavorText: A portable incense holder carved in the shape of an Imperial ship.
name: Lacquered Navicula

title: Velvet Medallion Holder
flavorText: A small velvet pouch intended to keep religious medallions in pristine condition while traveling. (Currently empty.)
name: Velvet Medallion Holder

title: Hanging Armor Creche
flavorText: A space-saving collection of connected straps and hooks. Attach to a smithy's rafters to store an entire set of armor above you.
name: Hanging Armor Creche

title: Illustrated Arms Folio
flavorText: A book of colorful illustrations depicting a variety of weapons throughout Tamriel.
name: Illustrated Arms Folio

title: Illustrated Amor Folio
flavorText: A book of colorful illustrations depicting a variety of armor fashions throughout Tamriel.
name: Illustrated Amor Folio

title: Dollmaker's Kit
flavorText: A small kit containing all the material needed to fashion dolls. The fine components could be resold to unscrupulous merchants.
name: Dollmaker's Kit

title: Slaughterfish Bobber
flavorText: A bobber with a simple enchantment to glow a soft green when it detects the presence of slaughterfish.
name: Slaughterfish Bobber

title: Orichalcum Mudcrab Cracker
flavorText: An ornate orichalcum shell cracker. Good for mudcrab dinners, or for torturing live mudcrabs still in their cages.
name: Orichalcum Mudcrab Cracker

title: Fast Forge Fire Salts Vial
flavorText: When sprinkled amidst the coals, the forge can be fired to its hottest temperature in less than a minute.
name: Fast Forge Fire Salts Vial

title: Tailor's Best Friend
flavorText: A statuette allowing one to design outfits in miniature. A clever mechanism inside can expand the statuette by a hand's width.
name: Tailor's Best Friend

title: Statuette of a Daedric Dog
flavorText: Statuette of a dog with a strangely human expression on its face; said to be associated with Clavicus Vile.
name: Statuette of a Daedric Dog

title: Kyne's Token
flavorText: A Nord ornament, polished from much handling, sacred to Kyne, goddess of the storm.
name: Kyne's Token

title: Copper Dragon Claw
flavorText: A three-toed Dragon's-foot wrought in copper; its function is unknown.
name: Copper Dragon Claw

title: Attunement Sphere
flavorText: A strange globe of Dwarven metal, ancient and mysterious.
name: Attunement Sphere

title: Dwemer Puzzle Cube
flavorText: A square device of Dwarven metal, with untranslatable runes on every surface.
name: Dwemer Puzzle Cube

title: Satchel of Laundered Goods
flavorText: This sack contains valuables that were obtained… less than legally.
name: Satchel of Laundered Goods

flavorText: Use to learn the Dro-m'Athra crafting style. Requires Rank 10 of any of the Metalworking, Tailoring, or Woodworking passives. Also teaches the equivalent Dro-m'Athra Outfit Styles.

title: Wrothgar Daily Contract Recompense
flavorText: Compensation from the Dragonstar Caravan Company for fulfilling a daily job contract in Wrothgar.
name: Wrothgar Daily Contract Recompense

title: Wrothgar Daily Contract Recompense
flavorText: Compensation from the Dragonstar Caravan Company for fulfilling a daily job contract in Wrothgar.
